computation_scope.movement: Only stand305 lanes4–7 with active=True and nonzero requested yaw, on exact5Hz lattice time_s=.02+n*.2 with1e-8s tolerance. Exactly45 samples per lane=180 per candidate; first1.02s,last9.82s. omega[lane][2] is actual yaw rate; requested/applied[lane][1] are the two reference rates. Means/MAEs use equal weight only across these180 samples.
computation_scope.extra_FSM_event_samples: Raw trace includes additional terminal/FSM-triggered samples. These are counted for provenance but excluded from movement aggregates. No224/other unweighted mixed-event denominator is used.
computation_scope.quiet: Separate original native50Hz metrics,2000 total frames=4 replicas×500 ticks, warmup0. Actual applied yaw reaches zero at10.24s and full quiet window ends20.24s in all four worlds. Group0episodes does not imply a missing window; terminal at22s is outside quiet mask.
computation_scope.prefix: Compare five stored physical fields on common5Hz grid while both replicas are active and strictly before the earliest nonnull firstBLEND timestamp. Per-lane maxima and first sampled differences are saved; all-active maxima are separate. Sparse sampled agreement does not establish all200Hz state or hidden solver/RNG equivalence.
computation_scope.ended: All first episodes count:4 replicas per scene/28 total; fallen denominator16 includes5 native script_timeout failures and11 complete full-chain successes. Counts crosschecked against native ledger/diagnostics, terminal events and native metric successes/failures.
